Compliance

The rules Recharge helps you manage in record time.

Every rule asks the same three things: where the material came from, who handled it and who is buying it. Today each deal answers them from scratch, and know-your-customer checks alone take months. Recharge answers them once, at the source, and carries the answer on the record. Months become days.

Without RechargeMonths
  • Request documents
  • Chase suppliers
  • Re-check origin
  • Legal review
  • Approve
With RechargeDays
Checked once at the source, then read by everyone.

Advanced materials science

Regenerate removes the smelter.

Regenerate InsideThe mark for plants and materials that run on Regenerate.

Conventional battery recycling is a dirty process that melts spent battery paste in a furnace above 1,200°C. Regenerate’s clean, water-based process takes it straight to battery-grade material at a fraction of that temperature, with virtually no air emissions, far less energy and a much lower carbon footprint.

It’s modular, so it fits inside existing plants and scales with them, at lower capital and operating cost than a smelter. And what comes out is better than what went in: ultra-pure, nano-structured materials that outperform conventional oxides and make better batteries.

Why now

Europe, the U.S. and the UK are all asking for proof.

Provenance, custody and evidence are becoming conditions of doing business in critical materials. One record answers all three.

European Union

Digital battery passport

18 Feb 2027
Mandatory · 0 days to go

From that date, covered batteries cannot be placed on the EU market without a digital battery passport. The duty falls on whoever places them there, yet most of the data sits upstream, out of their reach.

What the record doesThe data the EU battery passport asks for is already on the record before the battery exists.
United States

Allocation order

27 Aug 2026
In force for one year

Under the Defense Production Act, black mass and tungsten scrap must be sold to U.S. persons and cannot leave the country without authorization. From 1 January 2027, defense supply chains add a second test: covered tungsten, tantalum and samarium-cobalt magnets cannot be mined, refined or produced in China, Russia, Iran or North Korea.

What the record doesCompliance is a proof problem: what the material is, where it came from and who bought it.
United Kingdom

Digital waste tracking

Oct 2026
Mandatory for waste receiving sites

Permitted and licensed waste receiving sites must record every waste movement in the government’s digital service, with carriers, brokers and dealers following in April 2027.

What the record doesBattery scrap and black mass move as waste until they are recovered. The record carries the movement data with the material.
